source.title: Comparison of Effectiveness Among Different Sodium-Glucose Cotransoporter-2 Inhibitors According to Underlying Conditions: A Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

findings: The published title itself spells Cotransoporter-2; exact metadata preserves that source wording.
The main-text screening sentence is compressed/ambiguous; Supplementary Figure S1 supplies the explicit PRISMA flow counts and governs the precise flow summary.
The network contains placebo-controlled edges only, so active-agent contrasts are indirect and no closed-loop inconsistency test is possible.

extraction_limitations: This is secondary evidence. Result atoms describe the review network and do not imply that Kani et al. enrolled the underlying trial participants.

The extraction preserves independently reviewable methods, efficacy, subgroup, safety, sensitivity, interpretation, and limitation assertions without atomizing every matrix cell in Supplementary Tables S10-S32.
Exact numeric orthostatic-hypotension pairwise estimates were not recoverable from the supplied graph text layer, so that signal is retained qualitatively rather than invented.
Bibliographic entries were exported separately and were not atomized.
All atoms remain needs_review because no independent human verification step is represented.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
